claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting implicit discourse relations, with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing Comparison and Temporal implicit discourse relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
Explicit discourse relations are recognized with high accuracy, achieving F1 scores greater than 90%.
Implicit discourse relations are generally more difficult to identify compared to explicit ones due to the lack of discourse connectives.
